p43Diagnosis.trigger: P4.3 G4 check 4.3 fail: schema-diff.mjs returned 29 diffs (evidence/P4.3-schema-diff.json); checks 4.0/4.1/4.2/4.4/4.5 passed
p43Diagnosis.rootCause: Not a copy defect. All 29 diffs come from schema-diff.mjs comparing a PG16 source to a PG18 target without normalizing two known representation differences; the target already matches the source for every object in the copy scope (public schema). No target-side change can or should remove them.

rowLevel.method: fresh fingerprint.mjs --rows on both sides (neon-https, readOnly:true), compared per id by md5(t::text) (+ updated_at for blog_posts); row contents never printed

diffClassification.detail: Target PG 18.6 per A1 C2 (target major >= source major, SPEC-03 §4 pre-check). Not fixable on target, by design.

Source _system holds only Replit platform bookkeeping: 1 table (replit_database_migrations_v1), 1 sequence, 2 indexes, 0 functions; 0 pg_depend links from public objects into _system; no app code references it. SPEC-03 §4 dumps --schema=public only, so it is correctly absent on the target. Creating it on the target would import Replit-internal state; not done.

PG18 stores column NOT NULL as pg_constraint rows (contype=n); PG16 does not (source has 0 contype=n rows). Source attnotnull count in public = 27, target attnotnull = 27, target contype=n = 27 (all validated, none NO INHERIT); each of the 27 maps to a column with nullable=false on BOTH inventories. schema-diff.mjs already compares nullability through table_columns, which reports no diff. Removing them on PG18 would drop the NOT NULL itself, so no target fix.

normalizedDiff.method: scratch-only re-run of schema-diff.mjs diffInventories() on the same fresh inventories after dropping the source-only _system schema and contype=n constraints, and setting aside the accepted pgMajor diff (docs/migration/.scratch/p43fix-normalized-diff.mjs)

p43Diagnosis.targetAction: none. Target not modified, copy not re-run: row-level and object-level comparison show the target is already a faithful copy of source public; re-running the copy into an empty target would reproduce the same 29 diffs.
p43Diagnosis.recommendedResolution: Either A1/orchestrator formally accepts exactly these 29 classified diffs for G4 4.3 (and again for G6), or scripts/migration/db/schema-diff.mjs (P1.1-owned, needs its review path) gains: (1) ignore constraints with type=n since nullability is compared via columns, (2) treat _system (Replit platform schema) as a source-only excluded schema, (3) report pgMajor as info when b > a. Then re-run P4.3. The db-operator did not edit the harness.
p43Diagnosis.sourceAccess: every SRC_URL session readOnly:true (transaction_read_only=on confirmed in probe); no DDL/DML on source
